card.name: Graphs on 16 vertices with 65 edges whose triangles have small degree sums

task.name: Graphs on 16 vertices with 65 edges whose triangles have small degree sums
task.description: construct() -> {'n': 16, 'edges': [[u, v], ...]}: a simple graph on 16 vertices with exactly 65 = floor(16^2/4) + 1 edges (so it has triangles). The score is the largest degree sum deg(u) + deg(v) + deg(w) over its triangles. Minimize. Scores below 24 would beat the published construction at n = 16; the conjectured asymptotic value is about 1.464n = 23.4.
